business_problem: Lion employees had to navigate dozens of disconnected channels and siloed systems to get HR, IT, and finance help, which limited self-service and slowed issue resolution.
solution_summary: Lion employees had to navigate dozens of disconnected channels and siloed systems to get HR, IT, and finance help, which limited self-service and slowed issue resolution. Lion implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Employee Center, HR Service Delivery, and IT Service Management. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Employee Center provides a single employee portal; HR Service Delivery manages HR cases and onboarding; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests. The stack also connected DocuSign so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Requests enter through Employee Center, and uses context from DocuSign before ServiceNow AI Platform, HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, and DocuSign routes or fulfills the work.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: Employee Center
solution_components.role: Serves a single portal for requests, knowledge, and support interactions.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Moves HR cases, onboarding, and employee support workflows onto the same platform.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: DocuSign
solution_components.role: Handles digital signature steps triggered from HR and employee workflows.

data_flow: Requests enter through Employee Center, and uses context from DocuSign before ServiceNow AI Platform, HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, and DocuSign routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
business_outcome: Lion reduced IT tickets by 60%, cut resolution time by 77%, increased portal usage 350%, and improved service satisfaction while consolidating support into one portal.
metrics: 1 Unified portal instead of 56 channels for HR services
evidence_quotes: With such a complex and siloed environment, it was difficult for employees to know where to go and find the right information to get things done
Using Service Catalogs and automated workflows to assign tickets directly to the Resolver Team, the volume of IT tickets has been reduced by 60% in just one year
User surveys have also highlighted an average employee satisfaction score of over 90% for the ease of access and use enabled by managing requests through a single platform
With an increase in cyberattacks in Australia and around the world, Lion deployed ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) to track and manage cybersecurity risk and incidents
Using Risk Management within IRM, Lion now has better visibility to prioritize activities based on automated risk scores, and then assign tasks to the right IT team for resolution
